title: Kusanagi Nene — Because I'm Not Enough〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“H-Huh?!
Who's there...?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “N-No, stay away...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This doesn't feel like the right way to go...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wanna say that I've captured her fear of humans pretty well...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
As usual, day in and day out, this forest could not be more obnoxious.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Worst of all, I am unable to sleep the way I wish... And the way these trees shake is unbearable...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm not really moving like a cowardly canary yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which I need to fix. I have to get a better grasp of my character before we start practicing the scenes with her...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I should try searching for more canary videos again...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, these are all about their calls...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanna see a video that shows their wary and standoffish nature, and how they fly away... But I'm struggling to find any.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As much as I want to watch a real canary and learn how to act like one, I don't have that kind of time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I should probably try watching the birds around me and figure out how to...)

rows.Speaker: Sparrow
rows.Line: Chirp, chirp!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? A sparrow...?
Oh, it's on that tree branch...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, I can take a video of it flying.
I'll just turn my camera on and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Okay, approach it...slowly...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Hm...? It's at full zoom...
But it's still tiny... I'll try getting closer and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It flew away...
We even made eye contact.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did my video turn out? Oh, it's totally out of focus...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that situation just now was really similar to the scene when Rio meets the canary. If I try a little harder, I might be able to take a better video...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let's give it a try...!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I spent a lot of yesterday trying to take better videos of sparrows...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you couldn't?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nope... My hope was to sort of do what you did with those ducks, Emu. But things didn't work out for me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I was wondering if you could show me how to act more like the animal I'm trying to play without scaring them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sure, I'll be more than happy to help!
Easy peasy lemon cheesy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
But you probably meant “squeezy” not “cheesy”, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Hey, look, a sparrow!
I'll try talking to it♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, lemme get my phone ready...
Okay, go for it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How Emu acts should also help me a lot. I need to watch them both closely...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Chirp... Chirp, chirp.

rows.Speaker: Sparrow
rows.Line: Chirp...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The sparrow's looking at Emu...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Chirp, chirp-chirp, chirp♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, Emu's sort of keeping her distance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Is she doing that to give it a chance to not feel scared and become more comfortable with her...?)

rows.Speaker: Sparrow
rows.Line: Ch-Chirp...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, it just took a step towards her...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. The way you hop with each step is so cute☆ Lemme try! Hop-hop♪

rows.Speaker: Sparrow
rows.Line: Chirp?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! I'm sorry! Did that scare you?

rows.Speaker: Sparrow
rows.Line: Chirp...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it flew away...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry, Nene...
I tried...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that was really helpful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You made some good points about how it walks and stuff. Plus, I captured the moment it decided to fly away.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, Emu, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... If you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I wanna try practicing what I just saw...
Would you mind watching what I do for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Of course☆ Oh, then!
Nene, would you mind listening to me sing? I'm kinda worried about how I sound right now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! That means we get to teach each other!
